    import sys
    input_str = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    
    n = len(input_str)
    ans = 0
    count = 1
    for i in range(n - 1):
        if input_str[i] == input_str[i + 1]:
            count += 1
        else:
            if count % 2 == 0:
                ans += 1
            count = 1
    if count % 2 == 0:
        ans += 1
    
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
